summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a Form 6-K attaching two press releases dated September 16, 2026. The first designates Greece as its home member state and the Hellenic Capital Market Commission as competent authority under Greek law 3556/2007 (the local equivalent of a US Exchange Act reporting-home-state designation). The second, following parallel listing of all 116,071,386 common shares, par $0.01, on the Main Market of Euronext Athens, discloses total voting rights of 116,071,386 as the transparency-notification denominator. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine regulatory/listing notice, not a special situation.
